% TS_campaign_points, note below the table. Generated by analysis/paper_assets_isc.py; do not edit.
The table gives the success rate of the mixed campaign minus that of the campaign on the home device, in percentage points, when a share s of jobs runs on the other device. Policy: home device $\rightarrow$ other device. s: share of jobs sent to the other device (an assumption). Job: a prediction, or a target with all its seeds. Study: the study whose predictions are used (main study 60 targets; FU11 72). Rerun: the same campaign rerun on the home device, named in the cell, in a second compilation (for policy 4 also on the L4). Point estimates: the expectation over assignments. The 95\% intervals are over 10\,000 replicates resampling targets and assignments. The CPU ran seeds 1 and 2 once, so policy 3 uses those seeds and has no CPU rerun.
